# graphiant_content_filters (Data Source)

Lists all Graphiant global content filters, with rules/scope resolved to display names. Use graphiant_content_filter for a specific filter's ID-based config.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_content_filters" "all" {}

output "content_filter_names" {
  value = [for f in data.graphiant_content_filters.all.content_filters : f.name]
}
```
